PROJECT.PAGEHEADERCENTER: Ažuriranje dodatne klase robe za kasu
PROJECT.NAME: Ažuriranje dodatne klase robe za kasu
PROJECT.CAPTION: Ažuriranje dodatne klase robe za kasu

FILTERFORM.NAME: FILTERFORM
FILTERFORM.CAPTION: Upišite uvjete prikaza
FILTERFORM.ONSUBMIT: select klmasterrobaid,sortkey as [Sortkey1500],naziv as [Naziv4000],klasakasa as [Klasa robe za kasu1500]from klmasterroba where len(rtrim(sortkey))=coalesce(@@nivo,0)*2 or coalesce(@@nivo,0) = 0 order by sortkey,naziv

POKAZISVEFORM.NAME: POKAZISVEFORM
POKAZISVEFORM.ONSUBMIT: select klmasterrobaid,sortkey as [Sortkey1500],naziv as [Naziv4000],klasakasa as [Klasa robe za kasu1500] from klmasterroba order by sortkey,naziv

UPDATEFORM.NAME: UPDATEFORM
UPDATEFORM.CAPTION: Izmjena dodatne klase robe za kasu
UPDATEFORM.ONLOAD: select klmasterrobaid,sortkey,naziv,klasakasa from klmasterroba where klmasterrobaid=@@id
UPDATEFORM.ONSUBMIT: select klmasterrobaid,sortkey as [Sortkey1500],naziv as [Naziv4000],klasakasa as [Klasa robe za kasu1500]from klmasterroba where len(rtrim(sortkey))=coalesce(@@nivo,0)*2 or coalesce(@@nivo,0) = 0 order by sortkey,naziv

INPUT.NAME: ok
INPUT.CAPTION: Spremi
INPUT.ONCLICK: update klmasterroba set klasakasa='@@klasakasa' where klmasterrobaid=@@id#Ok
